name: Alertness
description: +2 bonus to [[spot]] and [[listen]] checks due to finely tuned senses.

name: Ambidexterity
description: When [[dual-wield|fighting with two weapons]], this [[feat]] reduces the penalty of the [[off-hand]] weapon by 4.

name: Animal companion (feat)
description: An [[animal companion]] may be [[summon]]ed once per [[day]], until killed or unsummoned.

name: Animate dead (feat)
description: Once per day a pale master may [[animate dead]] as a spell-like ability.

name: Arcane defense

repeatable_raw.quote: The character gains a +2 bonus to [[saving throw]]s versus the chosen school of magic.

description: The character gains a +2 bonus to [[saving throw]]s versus the chosen school of magic.

name: Armor proficiency (heavy)
description: This feat grants the knowledge to make effective use of [[heavy armor]].

name: Armor proficiency (light)
description: This feat grants the knowledge to make effective use of [[light armor]].

name: Armor proficiency (medium)
description: This feat grants the knowledge to make effective use of [[medium armor]].

name: Armor skin
description: The character gains a natural +2 bonus to [[armor class]].

name: Arrow of death
description: At 10th level, an arcane archer can enchant an arrow once per day that forces a target, if damaged by the arrow, to make a [[fortitude]] [[save]] or be slain.

name: Artist
prereq_raw: Can only take this feat at 1st-level, ''[[perform]] skill''
description: Character gains a +2 bonus on [[perform]] and [[spot]] checks.

name: Aura of courage
description: A character with this feat is immune to [[fear]].

name: Automatic quicken spell
prereq_raw: 21st level, [[quicken spell]], [[spellcraft]] 30, ability to cast 9th level spells

repeatable.quote: This feat may be taken multiple times:

description:
This feat allows the character to cast spells with a moment of thought. This feat may be taken multiple times:
* Automatic quicken spell I: Quicken any level 0 - 3 spells.
* Automatic quicken spell II: Quicken any level 4 - 6 spells.
* Automatic quicken spell III: Quicken any level 7 - 9 spells.

name: Automatic silent spell
prereq_raw: 21st level, [[silent spell]], [[spellcraft]] 24, ability to cast 9th level spells

repeatable.quote: This feat may be taken multiple times:

description:
This feat allows the character to cast all spells of a given level range without the caster making any sound. This is especially useful if the caster has been [[silence]]d. This feat may be taken multiple times:
* Automatic silent spell I: Cast any level 0 - 3 spell as a silent spell.
* Automatic silent spell II: Cast any level 4 - 6 spell as a silent spell.
* Automatic silent spell III: Cast any level 7 - 9 spell as a silent spell.

name: Automatic still spell
prereq_raw: 21st level, [[still spell]], [[spellcraft]] 27, ability to cast 9th level spells

repeatable.quote: This feat may be taken multiple times:

description:
This feat allows the character to cast all spells of a given level range as still spells automatically. These spells may be cast while wearing armor. This feat may be taken multiple times:
* Automatic still spell I: Cast any level 0 - 3 spell as a still spell.
* Automatic still spell II: Cast any level 4 - 6 spell as a still spell.
* Automatic still spell III: Cast any level 7 - 9 spell as a still spell.

name: Bane of enemies
description: Any weapon the character wields against any of their [[favored enemy|favored enemies]] is treated as a bane weapon for that creature type (+2 to hit and an additional +2d6 damage).

name: Barbarian fast movement
description: This feat gives the barbarian a 10% bonus to movement.

name: Barbarian rage
description:
The barbarian may '''rage''', gaining a +4 morale bonus to [[strength]] and [[constitution]] and +2 to all [[will]] [[saving throw]]s, in exchange for a -2 penalty to [[armor class]]. The barbarian may use this ability once per day at first [[class level|level]], +1 use per day at level 4, and every 4 levels thereafter, extending into [[epic class|epic]] levels.
At 15th level, the rage ability becomes '''greater rage''', giving the barbarian +6 to strength and constitution and +3 to will saves (the -2 penalty to armor class still applies).

name: Bard song
description: Bards are able to sing a song that can bolster their allies. [[Deaf]]ened [[creature]]s are not affected by the bard's singing. The song affects all allies within 30 feet and lasts for 10 [[round]]s. The higher the bard's final [[perform]] skill and class level, the better the bard song.

name: Bardic knowledge
description: This feat allows the character to identify items more easily than others. It grants the character a bonus equal to their [[class level]] to any [[lore]] checks.

name: Battle training vs. giants
description: This feat grants a +4 dodge bonus to [[armor class|AC]] against [[giant]]s.

name: Battle training vs. goblins
description: This feat grants a +1 racial bonus on [[attack roll]]s against [[goblinoid]]s (goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears).

name: Battle training vs. orcs
description: This feat grants a +1 racial bonus on [[attack roll]]s made against [[orc]]s.

name: Battle training vs. reptilians
description: This feat grants a +1 racial bonus on [[attack roll]]s against [[reptilian]] humanoids.

name: Blind fight
description: This feat grants the character the ability to fight well, even if [[blind]]ed or against [[invisible]] creatures. The character gets to re-roll its miss chance percentile one time to see if it actually hits. Furthermore, invisible creatures get no bonus to hit the character in melee.

name: Blinding speed
description: The character is able to cast [[haste]] on himself once per day. The effect will last 10 [[round]]s.

forbidden_for_raw.quote: This feat cannot be selected when taking a level of [[Harper scout]].

name: Blindsight, 60 foot radius
description: Using nonvisual senses, such as sensitivity to vibrations, scent, acute hearing, or echolocation, the creature maneuvers and fights as well as a sighted creature. [[Invisibility]] and [[darkness]] are irrelevant. The creature usually does not need to make [[spot]] or [[listen]] checks to notice creatures within the range of its blindsight ability (60 feet).

name: Blooded
prereq_raw: Can only take this feat at 1st-level.
description: The character gains a +2 bonus on [[initiative]] and a +2 bonus on [[spot]] checks.

name: Bone skin
description: The pale master gains an innate +2 bonus to their [[armor class|AC]] at 1st, 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, 20th, 24th, and 28th [[class level]]s.

name: Brew potion
use: selected (In order to brew a potion, the character has to cast the spell in question on an empty [[magical potion bottle]].)
description:
The character can create a [[potion]] of any spell of third [[innate level|level]] or lower that the character knows and that targets a single creature. Brewing a potion will cost a small amount of [[experience point|XP]] as well as some gold to cover the material cost. The cost for brewing a potion depends on the [[innate level]] of the spell as well as the [[caster level]] of the resulting potion.
Some examples: * A potion of [[bless]] (1) will cost 50 gold and 2 XP. * A potion of [[prayer]] (5) will cost 750 gold and 30 XP.

name: Bullheaded
prereq_raw: Can only take this feat at first level.
description: The character gains a +2 bonus on resisting [[taunt]]s and a +1 bonus on [[will]] [[saving throw]]s.

name: Bull's strength (feat)
description: Starting at second level, a blackguard may cast ''[[bull's strength]]''.

name: Called shot
description: Grants the ability to make a potentially disabling attack against an opponent's arms or legs. Called shots are made at a -4 penalty, and must overcome the target's [[discipline]] [[skill check]]. A successful called shot against the legs reduces the opponent's movement rate by 20% and gives them a -2 cumulative penalty to their [[dexterity]]. A successful called shot against the arms applies a cumulative -2 penalty to the creature's [[attack roll]]s.

name: Cat's grace (feat)
description: A Harper scout at third level is able to cast the spell [[cat's grace]] once per day.

name: Circle kick
description: If the character succeeds in hitting an opponent with an [[unarmed strike|unarmed attack]], that character gets an additional [[free attack]] against another, nearby enemy. There is a maximum of one free attack per [[round]].

name: Cleave
description: If the [[character]] kills an opponent, he gets a [[free attack]] against any opponent who is within [[melee]] weapon range.

template.special: [[Monk]]s receive this feat at first level.

name: Combat casting
description: The [[character]] is adept at casting spells in combat, and does not suffer the standard -4 penalty to [[concentration]] checks when [[defensive casting|casting defensively]] within four [[meter]]s of an enemy.

name: Construct shape
use: selected (After choosing the ability, the character must select the type of construct to change into.)
description: The character can shift into the following [[construct]] forms three times per day: [[iron golem form (shifter)|iron golem]], [[stone golem form|stone golem]], or [[demonflesh golem form|demonflesh golem]].

name: Contagion (feat)
description: Starting at seventh level, a blackguard may cast [[contagion]].

name: Courteous magocracy
prereq_raw: Can only take this feat at first level.
description: The character gains a +2 bonus on [[lore]] checks and [[spellcraft]] checks.

name: Craft harper item
description: Once per day, the Harper may make a magical [[potion]].

name: Craft wand
use: selected (In order to craft a wand, the character has to cast the spell in question on a specially crafted [[bone wand]].)
description:
The spellcaster can create a [[wand]] of any spell of fourth [[innate level|level]] or lower that he knows. Crafting a wand costs a small amount of [[experience point|XP]] and gold, depending on the level of the spell to be crafted into the wand. A newly created wand has 1[[d20]] + 1 [[charge]] per [[caster level|level]] of the character ''caster'' (up to a maximum of 50 charges). The cost for crafting a wand depends on the level of the spell as well as the [[caster level|level]] of the resulting wand.
Some examples: * A wand of [[magic missile]] (5) will cost 3750 gold and 150 XP. * A wand of [[Melf's acid arrow]] (5) will cost 7500 gold and 300 XP. * A wand of [[fireball]] (5) will cost 11250 gold and 450 XP.

name: Create undead (feat)
description: A blackguard may summon a [[ghast (summon)|ghast]] once per day. At seventh level, this ability improves and a [[doom knight]] is summoned instead.

name: Crippling strike
description: The rogue deals an additional 2 points of ability score [[strength]] damage when he makes a successful sneak attack.

name: Curse song
description: [[Bard]]s are able to sing a song that can curse their enemies. [[Deaf]]ened creatures are not affected by the bard's singing. The song affects all enemies within 30 feet and lasts for 10 [[round]]s. The higher the bard's final [[perform]] skill and [[class level]], the more powerful the curse song.

name: Damage reduction (barbarian)
description: These feats allow the barbarian to shrug off points of damage from each attack that causes damage.

name: Dark blessing
description: Blackguards add their [[charisma]] [[ability modifier|bonus]] to all [[saving throw]]s.

name: Darkness (feat)
description: Starting at fifth level, an assassin gains the ability to cast [[darkness (spell)|darkness]].

name: Darkvision
description: This feat grants the ability to see in the dark.

name: Death attack
description: At first level, an assassin may use a '''death attack''', which functions similarly to a [[sneak attack]] in that if the target is not in combat they become victim to the death attack. The successful attack forces the target to make a [[fortitude]] [[saving throw|save]] or become [[paralyze]]d. Even if they succeed with the saving throw they still suffer +1[[d6]] points of damage in addition to the normal damage the attack caused. This damage increases to 2d6 at [[class level|level]] 3, 3d6 at level 5, 4d6 at level 7, and 5d6 at level 9.

name: Deathless master touch
description: At 10th level a pale master's touch becomes deadly, instantly killing unless a [[difficulty class|DC]] 17 [[fortitude]] [[save]] is made.

name: Deathless mastery
description: At 10th [[class level|level]], a pale master becomes immune to [[critical hit]]s.

name: Deathless vigor
description: The pale master gains +3 [[hit point]]s per [[class level|level]].

name: Defensive awareness
description:
There are three versions of this feat with cumulative benefits.

'''(1):''' The [[character]] retains his [[dexterity]] bonus to [[armor class|AC]], even if caught [[flat-foot]]ed or attacked by a hidden or [[invisible]] creature.

'''(2):''' The character can no longer be [[flank]]ed, since he can react to opponents on opposite sides of him as easily as he can react to a single attack.

'''(3):''' The character gains an intuitive sense that alerts him to danger from traps, giving a +1 bonus to [[reflex]] [[save]]s made to avoid [[trap]]s.

name: Defensive roll
use: automatic, but limited to one use per [[day]]. [[Flat-foot]]ed characters cannot make a ''defensive roll''.
description: If the character is struck by a potentially lethal blow, he makes a [[reflex]] [[saving throw]] ([[difficulty class|DC]] = damage dealt). If successful, he takes only half damage from the blow.

name: Defensive stance
description:
When he needs to, the defender can become a stalwart bastion of defense. In this defensive stance, a defender gains phenomenal strength and durability, but he cannot move from the spot he is defending. He gains the following benefits:
* +2 [[strength]]
* +4 [[constitution]]
* +2 resistance bonus on all [[saving throw|save]]s
* +4 [[dodge bonus]] on [[armor class|AC]]
At first level, this ability can be used once per day. Every 2 [[class level|level]]s beyond 1, the dwarven defender gains an additional use per day.

name: Deflect arrows
use: Automatic if not caught [[flat-foot]]ed. [[Monk]]s receive this feat for free at [[class level|level]] 2.
description: The [[character]] can attempt to deflect one incoming missile attack per [[round]]. This is treated as a [[reflex]] [[save]] made against [[difficulty class|DC]] 20.

name: Deneir's eye
description: The Harper receives a +2 [[saving throw]] bonus vs. [[trap]]s.

name: Devastating critical
prereq_raw: [[strength]] 25+, [[cleave]], [[great cleave]], [[improved critical]] (weapon to be chosen), [[overwhelming critical]] (weapon to be chosen), [[power attack]], <del>[[weapon focus]] (weapon to be chosen)</del>

repeatable_raw.quote: Whenever scoring a [[critical hit]] with the chosen weapon, the character's target must make a [[fortitude]] [[saving throw|save]] or die instantly.

description: Whenever scoring a [[critical hit]] with the chosen weapon, the character's target must make a [[fortitude]] [[saving throw|save]] or die instantly. Creatures who are immune to critical hits are not affected by this feat.

name: Diamond body
description: The monk gains immunity to all [[poison]]s.

name: Diamond soul
description: The monk gains [[spell resistance]] equal to their [[class level]] + 10.

name: Dirty fighting
description: The character knows brutal and effective fighting tactics. By sacrificing all other attacks during the [[round]], the character can elect to perform a '''dirty fighting''' move that will deal an extra 1[[d4]] points of damage. This mode cannot be used with [[power attack]].

name: Disarm
use: selected. A disarm attempt provokes an [[attack of opportunity]].
description: The [[character]] can attempt to disarm an opponent in [[melee]] combat. Attempting a disarm applies a -6 penalty to the character's [[attack roll]], and the combatant with the larger weapon gains a +4 bonus per [[weapon size|size category]] of difference. A successful hit deals normal damage, and if the opponent fails a [[discipline]] [[skill check|check]] then the weapon flies from the opponent's hands.

name: Divine grace
description: The paladin adds  [[charisma]] [[ability modifier|bonus]] (if positive) to all [[saving throw]]s.

name: Divine health
description: The paladin is immune to [[disease]].

name: Divine might
description: The character may spend one of his ''turn undead'' attempts to add his [[charisma]] [[ability modifier|bonus]] to all weapon damage for a number of [[round]]s equal to the charisma bonus.

name: Divine shield
description: The character may spend one of his ''turn undead'' attempts to add his charisma [[ability modifier|bonus]] to his [[armor class]] for a number of [[round]]s equal to the charisma bonus.

name: Divine wrath
description: The champion is able to channel a portion of her deity's power once per day, giving her a +3 bonus on [[attack roll]]s, damage, and [[saving throw]]s for a number of [[round]]s equal to her [[charisma]] [[ability modifier|bonus]]. She also gains [[damage reduction]] of 5/+1. The attack and saving throw bonuses increase by +2 at level 10.

name: DM tool
description: All [[Dungeon Master|DM]] characters start with this instant feat. This feat does nothing unless implemented in a community-made [[module]]. The feat is implemented by editing the x3_dm_tool## [[script]] in the [[Toolset]].

name: Dodge
required_for_raw: [[mobility]], [[spring attack]], [[whirlwind attack]], [[improved whirlwind attack]], [[dwarven defender]], [[shadowdancer]], [[weapon master]]
use: Automatic, though a condition that negates a [[dexterity]] bonus to AC also negates any dodge bonuses. Multiple dodge bonuses (different [[feat]]s, racial bonuses) are cumulative.
description: The [[character]] gains a +1 dodge bonus to [[armor class|AC]] against attacks from his current target or latest attacker.

name: Draconic armor
description:
The character becomes more draconic in appearance. His skin develops tiny iridescent scales, nearly invisible. This provides increasing natural armor bonuses to his base [[armor class]].
{{{!}}class="wikitable" style="text-align:center"
 {{!}}-
   ! class level
   {{!}}  1 {{!}}{{!}}  5 {{!}}{{!}}  8 {{!}}{{!}} 10
   {{!}} 15 {{!}}{{!}} 20 {{!}}{{!}} 25 {{!}}{{!}} 30
 {{!}}-
   ! AC bonus
   {{!}} +1 {{!}}{{!}} +2 {{!}}{{!}} +3 {{!}}{{!}} +4
   {{!}} +5 {{!}}{{!}} +6 {{!}}{{!}} +7 {{!}}{{!}} +8
{{!}}}

name: Dragon abilities
description:
As the dragon disciple gains [[class level|level]]s in this [[prestige class]], his [[ability]] scores increase by the following table:
{{{!}}border=0 style="margin:-2ex 2em 0ex"
 {{!}}-
   {{!}} Level {{!}}{{!}} 
 {{!}}-
   {{!}} 2: {{!}}{{!}} +2 to [[strength]]
 {{!}}-
   {{!}} 4: {{!}}{{!}} +2 to strength
 {{!}}-
   {{!}} 7: {{!}}{{!}} +2 to [[constitution]]
 {{!}}-
   {{!}} 9: {{!}}{{!}} +2 to [[intelligence]]
 {{!}}-
   {{!}}10: {{!}}{{!}} +4 to strength, +2 to [[charisma]]
{{!}}}

name: Dragon breath
description: At third and seventh [[class level|level]], the dragon disciple begins to develop his ancestor's signature ability: a fiery breath weapon. While the [[fire damage|damage]] potential of the breath weapon slowly raises until reaching its full potential on level ten, save [[difficulty class|DC]] (19) and [[area of effect]] (30' cone) stay the same.

name: Dragon shape
prereq_raw: 21st level, [[wisdom]] 30+, either [[wild shape]] 6x/day or [[greater wildshape IV]]
use: selected. After selecting, the character must choose what type of dragon they will appear as.
description: The character may use wild shape to [[polymorph|change into]] a [[dragon]]. <strike>The transformation has a duration of 1 [[hour]] per [[class level]]</strike>.

name: Dual-wield (feat)
description: Rangers, when wearing [[light armor]], get all the benefits of having the [[ambidexterity]] and [[two-weapon fighting]] feats. While wearing [[medium armor|medium]] or [[heavy armor]] they lose these benefits.

name: Dwarven defender damage reduction
description:
At sixth level, the dwarven defender gains the ability to shrug off 3 points of damage from each blow or attack. At tenth level the [[damage reduction]] increases to 6 points of damage per attack or blow.
'''Epic progression:''' For each 4 [[class level|level]]s after 10, the damage reduction increases by 3 points.

name: Eagle's splendor (feat)
description: A Harper scout at fourth level is able to cast the spell [[eagle's splendor]] once per day.

name: Elemental shape
use: selected. After choosing the ability, the character must choose one of four elemental types (earth, air, fire, or water) to become.
description: The character with this ability can [[polymorph|take the shape of]] an elemental (a huge elemental at 16th [[class level|level]], and an elder elemental at 20th level). The ability may be used once per day at level 16, twice per day at level 17, and three times per day at level 19. At level 26 the druid is able to shift into elemental shape at will. The transformation has a duration of 1 [[hour]] per class level.

name: Empower spell
use: An empowered spell occupies a [[spell slot]] two levels higher than normal. [[Saving throw]]s and opposed rolls, such as those made when [[dispel magic]] is cast, are not affected.
description: All variable, numeric effects of an empowered spell are increased by 50%. For example, an empowered [[magic missile]] deals one and one-half times normal damage (1d4 + 1 multiplied by 1.5). Empowerment does not increase spell [[duration]].

name: Empty body
description: The monk is given 50% [[concealment]].

name: Enchant arrow
description: With this feat, every arrow an arcane archer nocks and lets fly gets a +1 [[enhancement bonus]]. The bonus only works for the arcane archer. For every 2 levels of arcane archer past 1st, the enhancement goes up by +1.

name: Epic barbarian damage reduction
description: An epic barbarian's [[damage reduction]] allows him to ignore the first 5 points of damage from any physical attack. This ability increases by +1 point every 3rd [[class level|level]] past 23rd.

name: Epic damage reduction

repeatable.quote: This feat may be taken up to three times, for damage reduction 6/-, then 9/-.

description: The character gains [[damage reduction]] 3/-. This feat may be taken up to three times, for damage reduction 6/-, then 9/-.

name: Epic dodge
description: The character avoids the first attack each [[round]].

name: Epic energy resistance

repeatable.quote: This feat may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of 100 resistance to each damage type.

description: The character gains [[damage resistance|resistance]] 10 to the selected damage type ([[acid damage|acid]], [[cold damage|cold]], [[electrical damage|electrical]], [[fire damage|fire]], or [[sonic damage|sonic]]). This feat may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of 100 resistance to each damage type.

name: Epic fiendish servant
description: The character's evil and hatred grow strong enough to attract the attention of an [[epic vrock]] when [[summon fiend|summoning a fiendish servant]] from the outer planes. This vile creature is a master in the arts of melee combat and, fueled by its master's evil soul, grows in strength and power as the blackguard gains new [[class level|level]]s.

name: Epic fortitude
description: The character gains a +4 bonus to all [[fortitude]] [[save]]s.

name: Epic prowess
description: The character's skill at combat grows and he gains a +1 bonus to all [[attack roll|attacks]].

name: Epic reflexes
description: The character has tremendously fast reflexes and gains a +4 bonus to all [[reflex]] [[save]]s.

name: Epic reputation
description: The character gains a +4 bonus to all [[bluff]], [[intimidate]], [[persuade|persuasion]] and [[taunt]] checks because they have become very well known.

name: Epic shadowlord
description: The character's [[summon shadow]] ability is reinforced, allowing him to call an [[epic shadowlord (summon)|epic shadowlord]] to his side. Unlike a non-epic shadowlord, an epic shadowlord is a potent fighter, reinforced by his master's lifeforce, making him stronger each time the shadowdancer gains a [[class level|level]].

name: Epic skill focus
prereq_raw: 21st level, 20 [[skill rank|rank]]s in the chosen skill

repeatable_raw.quote: The character gains a +10 bonus on all [[skill check]]s with the chosen [[skill]].

description: The character gains a +10 bonus on all [[skill check]]s with the chosen [[skill]].

name: Epic spell: dragon knight
prereq_raw: 21st level, the ability to cast 9th level spells, [[spellcraft]] 22
description: [[dragon knight|The caster summons a powerful adult red dragon to the targeted location to fight on his side]].

name: Epic spell: epic mage armor
prereq_raw: 21st level, the ability to cast 9th level spells, [[spellcraft]] 26
description: [[epic mage armor|The caster gets a +20 armor class bonus]].

name: Epic spell: epic warding
prereq_raw: [[epic class|epic level caster]], the ability to cast 9th level spells, [[spellcraft]] 34
description: [[epic warding|The spell conjures a powerful magical ward around the caster protecting against all  bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage]]. It grants [[damage reduction]] 50/+20 for 1 [[round]] per [[caster level|level]].

name: Epic spell focus
prereq_raw: 21st level, [[spell focus]] and [[greater spell focus]] in the chosen [[spell school|school]], ability to cast 9th level spells

repeatable_raw.quote: The character gains a +6 to the [[difficulty class]] for all [[saving throw]]s against spells from the chosen school of magic.

description: The character gains a +6 to the [[difficulty class]] for all [[saving throw]]s against spells from the chosen school of magic.

name: Epic spell: greater ruin
prereq_raw: 21st level, the ability to cast 9th level spells, [[spellcraft]] 25
description:
[[greater ruin|The caster deals 35d6 positive damage to a single target]].
'''Save:''' [[fortitude]] for half damage

name: Epic spell: hellball
prereq_raw: 21st level, the ability to cast 9th level spells, [[spellcraft]] 32
description: [[hellball|The caster creates a ball of energy that does 10d6 points of acid, fire, electrical and sonic damage to all targets in its blast radius]].

name: Epic spell: mummy dust
prereq_raw: 21st level, the ability to cast 9th level spells, [[spellcraft]] 15
description: [[mummy dust|The caster summons a powerful mummy warrior to do their bidding]].

name: Epic spell penetration
description: The character gains a +6 bonus on caster level checks to beat a creature's [[spell resistance]].

name: Epic superior weapon focus

repeatable_raw.quote: The weapon master gains a +1 bonus to all [[attack roll]]s with his weapon of choice at 13th level and every 3 levels afterwards.

description: The weapon master gains a +1 bonus to all [[attack roll]]s with his weapon of choice at 13th level and every 3 levels afterwards. This bonus [[stack]]s with the weapon master's [[superior weapon focus]] feat.

name: Epic toughness

repeatable.quote: This feat may be taken multiple times, up to a maximum of 200 hit points.

description: The character gains 20 [[hit point]]s. This feat may be taken multiple times, up to a maximum of 200 hit points.

name: Epic weapon focus
prereq_raw: 21st level, [[weapon focus]] with the chosen weapon

repeatable_raw.quote: The character gains a +2 bonus to all [[attack roll]]s with the chosen weapon.

description: The character gains a +2 bonus to all [[attack roll]]s with the chosen weapon.

name: Epic weapon specialization
prereq_raw: 21st level; [[weapon focus]], [[epic weapon focus]], and [[weapon specialization]] all in the chosen weapon

repeatable_raw.quote: The character gains a +4 bonus to all damage done by the chosen weapon.

description: The character gains a +4 bonus to all damage done by the chosen weapon.

name: Epic will
description: The character gains a +4 bonus to all [[will]] [[save]]s.

name: Evasion
description: Whenever a [[reflex]] [[save]] is allowed for half damage, the character instead takes no damage if he succeeds at the save.

name: Expertise
description: A character with this feat can make defensive attacks, gaining a +5 bonus to [[armor class|AC]] but receiving a -5 penalty to [[attack roll]]s.

name: Extend spell
use: An extended spell occupies a [[spell slot]] one level higher than normal. Spells with a duration of instantaneous or permanent are not affected.
description: Extended spells have their [[duration]] doubled, lasting twice as long as normal.

name: Extra music
description: The character may use ''bard song'' four extra times per day.

name: Extra smiting
description: This feat increases the smiting ability to 3 times per day.

name: Extra stunning attacks
description: The character gains 3 extra stunning attacks per day.

name: Extra turning
description: This divine ability allows the [[character]] to turn [[undead]] six additional times per day.

name: Favored enemy

repeatable.quote: The ranger may choose additional favored enemies every 5 levels.

use: automatic. The ranger may choose additional favored enemies every 5 levels. A Harper scout only chooses one more at level 5.
description: The character gains a +1 bonus to any damage delivered to his favored enemy. He also receives a +1 bonus on [[listen]], [[spot]], and [[taunt]] checks against the favored enemy. These bonuses improve by +1 for every 5 levels that the ranger gains, but they do <strike>not</strike> improve for the Harper.

name: Fear (feat)
description: Once per day, the purple dragon knight may cast the [[fear (spell)|fear spell]] with a [[caster level]] equal to his [[character level]].

name: Fearless
description: This feat grants a +2 bonus on [[saving throw]]s against [[fear]] spells and effects.

name: Final stand
description: Once per day, the purple dragon knight can inspire his troops to a heroic effort. Each ally in the area gains 2[[d10]] [[temporary hit point|hit point]]s. This ability can affect a number of people equal to his purple dragon knight level + [[charisma]] [[modifier]], and lasts for the same number of [[round]]s.

name: Flurry of blows
description: Monks receive an [[extra attack]] per [[round]] when fighting with [[unarmed strike|unarmed attack]]s or a [[kama]]. However, all attacks in that round suffer a -2 [[attack roll|attack]] penalty.

name: Ghostly visage (feat)
description: Starting at second level, an assassin gains the ability to cast [[ghostly visage]].

name: Good aim
description: This feat grants a +1 [[attack roll|attack]] bonus on attacks made with [[throwing weapon]]s.

name: Great charisma

repeatable.quote: This may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +10.

description: The character gains +1 to their [[charisma]]. This may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +10.

name: Great cleave
description: As ''cleave'', except that there is no limit to the number of additional attacks that the character may make after killing one opponent.

name: Great constitution

repeatable.quote: This may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +10.

description: The character gains +1 to their [[constitution]]. This may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +10.

name: Great dexterity

repeatable.quote: This may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +10.

description: The character gains +1 to their [[dexterity]]. This may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +10.

name: Great fortitude
description: A [[character]] with this feat is tougher than normal, gaining a +2 bonus to all [[fortitude]] [[saving throw]]s.

name: Great intelligence

repeatable.quote: This may be taken multiple times, to a maximum bonus of +10.

description: The character gains +1 to their [[intelligence]]. This may be taken multiple times, to a maximum bonus of +10.

name: Great smiting

repeatable.quote: This feat may be taken multiple times, up to a maximum of 10 times — each time adding additional damage equal to the character's level to the smite attack.

description: Whenever the character makes a successful smite attack, it adds two times the character's level to damage. This feat may be taken multiple times, up to a maximum of 10 times — each time adding additional damage equal to the character's level to the smite attack.

name: Great strength

repeatable.quote: This may be taken multiple times, to a maximum bonus of +10.

description: The character gains +1 to their [[strength]]. This may be taken multiple times, to a maximum bonus of +10.

name: Great wisdom

repeatable.quote: This may be taken multiple times, to a maximum bonus of +10.

description: The character gains +1 to their [[wisdom]]. This may be taken multiple times, to a maximum bonus of +10.

name: Greater spell focus

repeatable.quote: This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not [[stack]]. It applies to a different school of magic in each case.

use: automatic. This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not [[stack]]. It applies to a different school of magic in each case.
description: A character becomes even more adept with spells of a particular [[spell school|school of magic]]. The character gains a +4 bonus to the spell save [[DC]] for all spells of the chosen school.

name: Greater spell penetration
description: A +4 bonus to caster level checks is granted to the character when trying to beat a creature's [[spell resistance]].

name: Greater wildshape I
use: selected. After choosing the ability, the character must select which kind of wyrmling he wants to transform into.
description: The character with this ability can [[polymorph|take the shape of]] a [[wyrmling red dragon form|red]], [[wyrmling green dragon form|green]], [[wyrmling black dragon form|black]], [[wyrmling white dragon form|white]], or [[wyrmling blue dragon form|blue]] wyrmling <del>three</del> ''six'' times per [[day]]. He gains the wyrmling's signature ability, its breath weapon. As the shifter rises in [[class level|level]]s, the damage potential of the breath weapon increases.

name: Greater wildshape II
description: At third level, a shifter may [[polymorph|shift]] into various creature forms ([[minotaur form|minotaur]], [[harpy form|harpy]], [[gargoyle form|gargoyle]]) three times per day.

name: Greater wildshape III
description: At fifth level, a shifter may [[polymorph|shift]] into the the form of a [[manticore form|manticore]], [[basilisk form|basilisk]], or [[drider form|drider]] three times per day.

name: Greater wildshape IV
description: At tenth level, a shifter may [[polymorph|shift]] into the form of a large [[dire tiger form|dire tiger]], [[medusa form|medusa]], or [[mind flayer form|mindflayer]] three times per day.

name: Hail of arrows
description: In lieu of a regular attack, once per day an arcane archer can fire an arrow at each and every target within range, to a maximum of one target for every arcane archer level he has.

name: Hardiness vs. enchantments
description: This feat grants a +2 bonus on [[saving throw]]s against [[mind-affecting]] spells.

name: Hardiness vs. illusions
description: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus on [[saving throw]]s against [[mind-affecting]] spells.

name: Hardiness vs. poisons
description: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus on [[saving throw]]s vs. [[poison]].

name: Hardiness vs. spells
description: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus on [[saving throw]]s vs. [[spell]]s.

name: Heroic shield
description: You may aid an ally, giving them a +4 [[dodge bonus]] to their [[armor class]] for one [[round]].

name: Hide in plain sight
description:
The shadowdancer is able to use the [[hide]] skill even while being observed.
Note: This ability will not always be successful in the frenzy of combat, but disengaging from the enemy before attempting to ''hide in plain sight'' will succeed.

name: Hit die increase
description:
As the dragon disciple gains levels in this [[prestige class]], his base [[hit die]] type changes. This change is not retroactive.

name: Humanoid shape
description: At seventh level, a shifter may [[polymorph|shift]] into various humanoid forms. A shifter may do this three times per day.

name: Imbue arrow
description: At second level, an arcane archer gains the ability to summon a magical arrow and fire it at an enemy. If it hits, it explodes as a [[fireball]] spell, doing [[fire damage]] to all hostile creatures in the area of effect.

name: Immunity to fire
description: The character gains [[immunity]] to [[fire damage|fire]].

name: Immunity to paralysis
description: The red dragon disciple gains immunity to [[paralysis]].

name: Immunity to sleep
description: This feat grants immunity to all [[sleep]] spells and effects.

name: Improved combat casting
description: The character does not incur [[attack of opportunity|attacks of opportunity]] for casting spells while threatened.

name: Improved critical
prereq_raw: proficiency with the chosen weapon, [[base attack bonus]] +8

repeatable.quote: This feat can be selected multiple times, applying to a new weapon category each time.

use: automatic. The threat range of a [[keen]] weapon is already doubled, increasing to triple with this feat. This feat can be selected multiple times, applying to a new weapon category each time.
description: Combat ability increases the critical [[threat range]] of a selected weapon by a range equal to the item's base threat range. A [[longsword]] that normally threatens a critical on a roll of 19-20 would now threaten a critical on a roll of 17-20.

template.special: [[Halfling]]s and [[gnome]]s are small creatures, and as such they can never use the following large weapons: dire mace, double-bladed sword, doubleaxe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, and scythe.

name: Improved disarm
description: A [[character]] with this [[feat]] has learned not to provoke an [[attack of opportunity]] when attempting a disarm. Success knocks the opponent's weapon from his hands. The penalty to make a disarm attempt is reduced to -4.

name: Improved evasion
description: Whenever a [[reflex]] [[save]] is allowed for half damage, characters with this feat instead take no damage if they succeed at the save. Even if they fail the save, they take only half damage.

name: Improved expertise
description: A character with this feat can make defensive attacks, gaining a +10 bonus to [[armor class|AC]] but receiving a -10 penalty to [[attack roll]]s.

name: Improved initiative
description: The character gains a +4 bonus to [[initiative]] checks.

name: Improved invisibility (feat)
description: Starting at ninth level, an assassin gains the ability to cast [[improved invisibility]].

name: Improved ki strike 4
description: The monk's unarmed attack counts as a +4 magic weapon against creatures with [[damage reduction]].

name: Improved ki strike 5
description: The monk's unarmed attack counts as a +5 magic weapon against creatures with [[damage reduction]].

name: Improved knockdown
use: selected. [[Monk]]s receive this feat for free at level 6.
description: A [[character]] with this [[feat]] counts as one [[size category]] larger when he makes a [[knockdown]] attack. All other knockdown conditions still apply.

forbidden_for_raw.quote: Since monks receive this feat automatically, it cannot be selected when gaining a monk level (even prior to level 6).

name: Improved parry
description: The [[character]] gains a +4 competence bonus to his opposed <del>attack</del> roll when using the [[parry]] skill.

name: Improved power attack
description: This feat allows the character to trade a -10 penalty on his [[attack roll]] to gain a +10 bonus on his damage roll. It is very useful when fighting tough, easy-to-hit opponents.

name: Improved sneak attack

repeatable.quote: This feat may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +10d6.

description: Add +1[[d6]] to your sneak attack damage. This feat may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +10d6.

name: Improved spell resistance

repeatable.quote: This feat may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +20.

description: The character gains a +2 to [[spell resistance]]. This feat may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +20.

name: Improved stunning fist

repeatable.quote: This feat may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +20.

description: Adds +2 to the [[difficulty class|DC]] of the character's stunning attack. This feat may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +20.

name: Improved two-weapon fighting
use: automatic. [[Ranger]]s receive this feat at [[class level|level]] 9, even if they do not meet the requirements.
description: The character with this [[feat]] is able to get a second [[off-hand]] attack (at a penalty of -5 to his [[attack roll]]).

forbidden_for_raw.quote: Since rangers receive this feat automatically, it cannot be selected when gaining a ranger level (even prior to receiving it automatically).

name: Improved unarmed strike
use: automatic. Monks receive this feat for free at level 1.
description: Armed opponents no longer get [[attack of opportunity|attacks of opportunity]] against the character when he makes an [[unarmed strike|unarmed attack]].

name: Improved whirlwind attack
description: The character performs a full attack action and makes one melee attack at full [[base attack bonus]] against all opponents they threaten (10 feet).

name: Increased multiplier

repeatable_raw.quote: With their weapon of choice, the [[critical multiplier|multiplier]] is increased by x1 to all [[critical hit]]s.

description: With their weapon of choice, the [[critical multiplier|multiplier]] is increased by x1 to all [[critical hit]]s. Thus a x2 critical multiplier becomes a x3.

name: Infinite elemental shape
description: Upon reaching 26th [[class level|level]], a druid gains unlimited uses of his [[elemental shape]] ability.

name: Infinite greater wildshape
description:
The shifter's ability to shapeshift into different forms grows while he is gaining levels. At some point the shifter is able to change into certain forms an infinite number of times per day:
* Level 4: infinite [[greater wildshape I]]
* Level 7: infinite [[greater wildshape II]]
* Level 10: infinite [[greater wildshape III]]
* Level 13: infinite [[humanoid shape]]
* Level 16: infinite [[greater wildshape IV]]

name: Infinite wildshape
description: Upon reaching 22nd [[class level|level]], a druid gains unlimited uses of his [[wild shape]] ability.

name: Inflict critical wounds (feat)
description: Starting at eighth level, a blackguard may cast [[inflict critical wounds]].

name: Inflict serious wounds (feat)
description: Starting at sixth level, a blackguard may cast [[inflict serious wounds]].

name: Inspire courage
description: Once per day, the purple dragon knight can inspire his troops in combat. All affected creatures gain a +1 bonus to [[attack roll|attack]] and damage, and a +2 bonus against [[mind-affecting]] spells. These bonuses last for 10 [[round]]s.

name: Invisibility (feat)
description: The character is able to cast the spell [[invisibility (spell)|invisibility]] once per day.

name: Iron will
description: The character's strong presence of mind gives him a +2 bonus to all [[will]] [[saving throw]]s.

name: Keen sense
description: [[Character]]s with this [[feat]] may apply their full [[listen]], [[search]] and [[spot]] [[skill]]s even when making a [[detect|passive search]].

name: Ki critical

repeatable_raw.quote: The weapon master gains an additional +2 to the [[threat range]] of their weapon of choice.

description: The weapon master gains an additional +2 to the [[threat range]] of their weapon of choice.

name: Ki damage
description: Once per day per [[class level|level]], a weapon master may use this feat to do maximum damage to their opponent.

name: Ki strike
description: The monk's unarmed attack counts as a magic weapon against [[creature]]s with [[damage reduction]] (+1 at 10th level, +2 at 13th, +3 at 16th).

name: Knockdown
use: selected. Prone characters cannot attack. Characters receive a +4 bonus to attack prone opponents in melee, but a -4 penalty to attack them with a [[ranged weapon]]. A character can only make a ''knockdown'' attempt on opponents that are one [[size category]] larger than himself, or smaller. The opponent gets a +4 bonus on his opposed check for every size category he is larger than the attacker, or a -4 penalty for every size category he is smaller. [[Monk]]s receive this feat for free at level 6.
description: A character with this [[feat]] can attempt to knock his [[melee]] opponents to the ground. The character makes an [[attack roll]] at -4, and if successful the defender makes an opposed [[discipline]] [[skill check|check]] against the character's attack roll. If the character wins, the defender is knocked to a [[prone]] position.

forbidden_for_raw.quote: Since monks receive this feat automatically, it cannot be selected when gaining a monk level (even prior to level 6).

name: Lasting inspiration
description: This [[feat]] allows the effects of bardic music to last ten times longer.

name: Lay on hands
use: selected. When used against [[undead]] creatures, it is treated as a [[touch attack]] spell that delivers [[divine damage|damage]] instead of healing.
description: With this feat, characters can heal damage equal to their class level multiplied by their [[charisma]] [[ability modifier|modifier]].

name: Lightning reflexes
description: The character's reflexes are faster than normal, granting him a +2 bonus to all [[reflex]] [[saving throw]]s.

name: Lingering song
description: The effects of the [[bard]]'s songs will last an additional five [[round]]s.

name: Lliira's heart
description: The Harper receives a +2 [[saving throw]] bonus against mind-affecting spells.

name: Low-light vision
description: ''Low-light vision'' grants the ability to see in the dark, but not as far as [[darkvision]].

name: Luck of heroes
prereq_raw: Can only take this at first level.
description: The character gains a +1 bonus on all [[saving throw]]s.

name: Lucky
description: This feat grants a +1 racial bonus to all [[saving throw]]s.

name: Maximize spell
use: A maximized spell occupies a [[spell slot]] three levels higher than normal. [[Saving throw]]s and opposed rolls, such as those made when [[dispel magic]] is cast, are not affected.
description: Maximized spells apply all variable numeric effects — including damage, number of targets, and so on — at their maximum values.

name: Mighty rage
description: When the character rages, they gain +8 to [[strength]] and [[constitution]] and a +4 morale bonus to [[will]] saves. These bonuses replace the [[barbarian rage|normal rage]] bonuses.

name: Mobility
use: Automatic, though a condition that negates a dexterity bonus to AC also negates any dodge bonuses. Multiple dodge bonuses (from different [[feat]]s or racial bonuses) are cumulative.
description: A character with this feat has learned to avoid [[attack of opportunity|attacks of opportunity]] more effectively, gaining a +4 [[dodge bonus]] to [[armor class|AC]] against them.

name: Monk AC bonus
description: Monks add their [[wisdom]] [[modifier]] to their [[armor class]].

name: Monk speed
description: Monks move more quickly than other classes, and this ability improves with [[experience point|experience]].

name: Monster uncanny reflex
description: The monster cannot be caught [[flat-foot]]ed for any reason.

name: Mount actions
description: This series of actions enables players to interact with their mounts.

name: Mounted archery
description: The [[attack roll|attack]] penalty for using a bow while [[horse riding|mounted]] is reduced from -4 to -2.

name: Mounted combat
description: While [[horse riding|mounted]], once per round you will attempt a [[skill check|ride check]] to increase your [[armor class]] by 1 point for every 5 of the check result.

name: Nature sense
description: The druid gains a +2 bonus on all [[attack roll]]s made while fighting in wilderness areas.

name: Oath of wrath
description: Once per day, the purple dragon knight may swear to defeat a single opponent. He gains a +2 bonus to [[attack roll|attack]], damage, [[save]]s, and [[skill]]s vs. that opponent. This lasts for a number of [[round]]s equal to twice his [[class level]].

name: Opportunist
description: The rogue gains a +4 competence bonus to [[attack roll]]s when making [[attack of opportunity|attacks of opportunity]].

name: Outsider shape
use: selected. After choosing the ability, the character must select the type of outsider to change into.
description: The character can assume different outsider shapes three times per day — either an [[azer chieftain form|azer chieftain]], a [[rakshasa form|rakshasa]], or a [[death slaad form (shifter)|death slaad]].

name: Overwhelming critical

repeatable_raw.quote: When using the weapon chosen, the character deals +1d6 points of damage on a successful [[critical hit]].

description: When using the weapon chosen, the character deals +1d6 points of damage on a successful [[critical hit]]. If the weapon's [[critical multiplier]] is x3, add +2d6 and if the multiplier is x4, add 3d6.

name: Partial skill affinity (listen)
description: This feat grants a +1 racial bonus to [[listen]] checks.

name: Partial skill affinity (search)
description: This feat grants a +1 racial bonus to [[search]] checks.

name: Partial skill affinity (spot)
description: This feat grants a +1 racial bonus to [[spot]] checks.

name: Perfect health
description: This feat makes the character immune to all [[disease]]s and [[poison]]s.

name: Perfect self
description: The character gains immunity to all [[mind-affecting]] spells and effects, and [[damage reduction]] 20/+1.

name: Planar turning
use: <del>selected</del> ''automatic''. If the character has twice as many [[class level|level]]s as the outsiders have [[hit dice]], the outsiders are instantly destroyed.
description: This feat allows [[outsider]]s to be turned like [[undead]].

name: Player tool
description: This instant feat can be given to players to enable a behavior you desire. The feat does nothing unless implemented in a community-made [[module]]. The feat is implemented by editing the x3_pl_tool## [[script]] in the [[Toolset]] and then giving the feat to a [[player character]]. This can be done by adding an [[item property]] bonus feat to a [[skin item|creature skin]] that has been previously equipped on the player character through scripting.

name: Point blank shot
description: A character with this feat negates the -4 penalty for using [[ranged weapon|missile weapon]]s in melee, and gains an additional +1 to [[attack roll]] and damage with ranged weapons when the target is within 15 feet.

name: Poison save
description: Starting at second level, an assassin gains a natural [[saving throw]] bonus to all [[poison]]s of +1 for every 2 [[class level|level]]s.

name: Power attack
description: A character with this feat can make powerful but ungainly attacks. When ''power attack'' is selected, it grants a +5 bonus to the damage roll, but at the cost of -5 to the [[attack roll]].

name: Purity of body
description: The monk is immune to all non-magical [[disease]]s.

name: Quick to master
description: Humans start with an extra [[feat]] at character generation.

name: Quicken spell
use: Quickened spells occupy [[spell slot]]s four levels higher than normal.
description: Quickened spells can be cast instantaneously, making them invulnerable to [[counterspell]]s or interruption. A quickened spell is cast as a free action, and another action can be attempted within the same round, including the casting of another spell. Only one quickened spell can be cast per round.

name: Quivering palm
use: selected. ''Quivering palm'' may only be used on creatures at a lower level than the character. Creatures of the [[construct]] and [[undead]] types are immune to this effect, as are any creatures that are immune to [[critical hit]]s.
description: This ability may be used once per day to instantly kill an opponent. If the character makes a successful attack after activating the ability, the target must make a [[fortitude]] [[save]] ([[difficulty class|DC]] 10 + half the monk's [[character level]] + the monk's [[wisdom]] [[modifier]]) or die.

name: Rallying cry
description: Three times per day, a purple dragon knight can utter a powerful shout that gives all allies a +1 bonus to [[attack roll|attack]] and a 20% bonus to [[movement rate|land speed]] for one [[round]].

name: Rapid reload
description: The character is able to reload so quickly that she gets the same [[attacks per round|number of attack]]s with any [[crossbow]] as she would if she was using a normal [[bow]].

name: Rapid shot
description: A character with this [[feat]] gains an extra [[attack per round]] with a [[ranged weapon]] (excluding [[crossbow]]s). When a ''rapid shot'' is attempted, the extra attack is made at the character's highest [[base attack bonus]], but all attacks within the [[round]] suffer a -2 penalty.

name: Remove disease (feat)
description: A character with this feat may [[remove disease]] once per day.

name: Resist disease
description:
The character gains a +4 bonus on [[fortitude]] [[saving throw]]s to
resist the effects of [[disease]].

name: Resist energy

repeatable_raw.quote: resistance]] against the chosen type of energy.

description: The character gains +5 [[damage resistance|resistance]] against the chosen type of energy. (The first 5 points of damage of this type of energy are ignored.)

name: Resist nature's lure
description: This feat grants a +2 insight bonus on [[saving throw]]s against [[fear]] spells and effects.

name: Resist poison
description: The character gains a +4 bonus on [[fortitude]] [[saving throw]]s against [[poison]].

name: Sacred defense
description: ''Sacred defense'' adds a +1 bonus to all [[saving throw]]s for every 2 levels of champion of Torm.

name: Sap
description: A [[character]] with this feat is able to make a special stun attack in [[melee]]. He makes an [[attack roll]] with a -4 penalty, and if the hit successfully deals damage, the defender must make a [[discipline]] [[skill check|check]] with a [[difficulty class|DC]] equal to the attacker's attack roll. If the defender fails, he or she is [[dazed]] for 12 seconds.

name: Scribe scroll
use: selected (In order to scribe a scroll, the character has to cast the spell in question on a specially prepared [[blank scroll]].)
description:
The character can create a [[scroll]] of any spell that he knows. Scribing a scroll costs a small amount of [[experience point|XP]] and [[gold]], depending on the innate level of the spell to scribe. The cost for scribing a scroll depends on the [[innate level]] of the spell as well as the [[caster level]] of the resulting scroll.
Some examples:
* A scroll of [[bless]] (1) will cost 25 gold and 6 XP.
* A scroll of [[fireball]] (5) will cost 375 gold and 15 XP.
* A scroll of [[chain lightning]] (11) will cost 1650 gold and 66 XP.

name: Seeker arrow
description: At fourth [[class level|level]], an arcane archer gains the ability to launch an arrow once per day that cannot miss its target. At sixth level this ability can be used twice per day. This arrow is magically created at the moment the archer uses this ability.

name: Self concealment

repeatable.quote: This feat may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of 50% concealment.

description:
The character gains a 10% [[concealment]] bonus. This feat may
be taken multiple times, to a maximum of 50% concealment.

name: Shadow daze
description: Once per day the shadowdancer may inflict an illusory [[dazed|daze]] upon a target. This daze lasts for 5 [[round]]s.

name: Shadow evade
description: Three times per day the shadowdancer can call upon the shadows in the area to help conceal her. She gains a 5% [[concealment]] bonus, [[damage reduction]] of 5/+1, and a +1 [[armor class|AC]] [[dodge bonus|bonus]]. The effect lasts for 5 [[round]]s. This improves as the shadowdancer goes up in levels.

name: Shield proficiency
use: automatic. All ''(base)'' classes except [[monk]]s, [[rogue]]s, [[sorcerer]]s, and [[wizard]]s have this feat for free.
description: A character with this feat has the training required to use a [[shield]].

name: Silent spell
use: A silenced spell occupies a [[spell slot]] one level higher than normal.
description: Silent [[spell]]s are cast without a verbal [[component]].

name: Silver palm
prereq_raw: Can only take this feat at first level.
description: The character gains a +2 bonus on [[appraise]] and [[persuade]] checks.

name: Skill affinity (concentration)
description: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus to [[concentration]] checks.

name: Skill affinity (listen)
description: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus to [[listen]] checks.

name: Skill affinity (lore)
description: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus to [[lore]] checks.

name: Skill affinity (move silently)
description: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus to [[move silently]] checks.

name: Skill affinity (search)
description: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus to [[search]] checks.

name: Skill affinity (spot)
description: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus to [[spot]] checks.

name: Skill focus

repeatable.quote: This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not [[stack]]. It applies to a different skill in each case.

use: automatic. This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not [[stack]]. It applies to a different skill in each case.
description: A character with this feat is adept at a certain [[skill]], gaining a +3 bonus on all [[skill check|checks]] with it.

name: Skill mastery
description: When using the [[disable trap]], [[open lock]], and [[set trap]] skills, the character automatically [[take 20|takes 20]] on any [[skill check]]s, even if in combat.

name: Skilled
description: The [[character]] receives 4 extra [[skill point]]s at first level, plus 1 additional skill point at each following level.

name: Sleep (feat)
description: A Harper scout at second level is able to cast [[sleep (spell)|sleep]] once per day.

name: Slippery mind
description: Characters failing their [[will]] [[save]] versus [[mind-affecting]] spells get an automatic reroll.

name: Small stature
description:
Gnomes and halflings are small creatures. As such, they gain bonuses to their [[attack roll]]s, [[armor class]], and [[hide]] checks when dealing with larger creatures.
'''Note:''' Because they are so small, they cannot use the following weapons: [[dire mace]], [[two-bladed sword]], [[double axe]], [[greataxe]], [[greatsword]], [[halberd]], [[heavy flail]], [[quarterstaff]], [[scythe]], and [[spear]].

name: Smite evil
use: selected. ''Smite evil'' only affects evil creatures.
description: This feat allows the character to make a special attack against [[evil]] creatures. The character applies their [[charisma]] [[modifier]] to their [[attack roll]], and their [[class level]] to the damage delivered. ''Smite evil'' may be used once per day.

name: Smite good
description: Once a day, a blackguard of second level or higher may attempt to smite a [[good]] aligned enemy with one normal [[melee]] attack. The blackguard adds his [[charisma]] [[ability modifier|bonus]] to the [[attack roll]] and adds 1 extra point of damage per [[class level]].

name: Snake blood
prereq_raw: Can only take this at first level.
description: The character gains a +1 [[reflex]] [[saving throw]] bonus. Also, any saving throws versus [[poison]] gain an additional +2 [[fortitude]] bonus.

name: Sneak attack
use: automatic. Monsters of the [[construct]] and [[undead]] types are immune to sneak attacks, as are any creatures that are immune to critical hits.
description: Whenever the character makes a successful attack against an opponent who is [[flat-foot]]ed, cannot see them, or who is in combat with someone else, the character's blow delivers extra damage. This extra damage is +1[[d6]] at first level and an additional +1d6 every two [[class level|level]]s thereafter. This extra damage is not multiplied in the case of a [[critical hit]].

name: Sneak attack, blackguard
use: automatic. Monsters of the [[construct]] and [[undead]] types are immune to sneak attacks, as are any creatures that are immune to critical hits.
description: Whenever the character makes a successful attack against an opponent who is [[flat-foot]]ed, cannot see them, or who is in combat with someone else, the character's blow delivers extra damage. This extra damage is +1[[d6]] at fourth level and an additional +1d6 every three [[class level|level]]s thereafter. This extra damage is not multiplied in the case of a [[critical hit]].

name: Spell focus

repeatable.quote: This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not [[stack]]. It applies to a different school of magic in each case.

use: automatic. This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not [[stack]]. It applies to a different school of magic in each case. [[Gnome]]s receive ''spell focus ([[illusion]])'' for free at level 1.
description: A character with this feat is adept in a certain [[spell school|school of magic]], granting a +2 bonus to spell [[save]] [[DC]] for all spells cast from that school.

name: Spell penetration
description: A spellcaster with this feat gains a +2 bonus to caster level checks to beat a creature's [[spell resistance]].

name: Spring attack
description: Enemies do not get [[attack of opportunity|attacks of opportunity]] against the character when the character is moving around in combat.

name: Stealthy
description: The character gains a +2 bonus on [[hide]] and [[move silently]] checks.

name: Still mind
description: The monk gains a +2 competence bonus on all [[saving throw]]s against [[mind-affecting]] spells.

name: Still spell
use: A stilled spell occupies a [[spell slot]] one level higher than normal.
description: Still spells are cast without a somatic [[component]]. Any [[spell failure|penalties]] incurred from casting in armor do not apply to a spell prepared with this feat.

name: Stonecunning
description: This feat grants a +2 bonus on [[search]] checks made in interior areas.

name: Strong soul
prereq_raw: Can only take this feat at first level.
description: The character gains a +1 bonus to [[fortitude]] and [[will]] [[saving throw]]s, as well as a +1 bonus to any saving throw versus [[death magic]].

name: Stunning fist
use: selected. [[Monk]]s receive this feat for free at first level, even if they do not meet the prerequisites. As well, monks suffer no attack or damage penalties when using this feat and may use it once per day per [[class level|level]]. [[Construct]]s and [[undead]] are immune to this attack, as are any creatures that are immune to [[critical hit]]s.
description: A character with this feat can attempt a disabling strike with a -4 [[attack roll|attack]] penalty and a -4 damage penalty. If successful, the target must succeed at a [[fortitude]] [[save]] ([[difficulty class|DC]] 10 + 1/2 the attacker's [[character level|level]] + the attacker's [[wisdom]] [[modifier]]) or be [[stunned|held]] for three [[round]]s. This attack may be used once per day for every four [[character level|levels of the character]].

name: Summon familiar
description: A character with this feat may [[summon]] a [[familiar]] once per day. If the familiar dies, the character suffers 1[[d6]] [[magical damage]], but may summon the familiar again on the following [[day]].

name: Summon fiend
description: Starting at fifth level, a blackguard may [[summon]] a [[succubus (summon)|succubus]]. At ninth level this ability improves and grants the power to summon a [[vrock (summon)|vrock]].

name: Summon greater undead
description:
At ninth level, a pale master may [[summon]] a greater undead once per day as a spell-like ability. The pale master's [[class level|level]] determines the type of undead summoned:
* Level 9: [[mummy (pale master)|mummy warrior]]
* Level 10: [[spectre (pale master)|spectre]]
* Level 12: [[vampire rogue (summon)|vampire rogue]]
* Level 14: [[greater bodak]]
* Level 16: [[ghoul king]]
* Level 18: [[vampire mage (summon)|vampire mage]]
* Level 20: [[skeleton blackguard]]
* Level 22: [[lich (pale master)|lich]]
* Level 24: [[lich lord]]
* Level 26: [[alhoon (summon)|alhoon]]
* Level 28: [[alhoon elder]]
* Level 30: [[lesser demilich]]

name: Summon mount
description:
Summons to the paladin a faithful, magical beast — a [[paladin mount|warhorse mount]]. The beast is more powerful as the paladin gets more powerful.
'''Note:''' Horses and the [[ride]] skill are only used in the [[premium module]] "Neverwinter Nights - Wyvern Crown of Cormyr" and specific community-made [[module]]s.

name: Summon shadow
description: Once per day the shadowdancer can [[summon]] a [[shadow]]. This shadow is extremely difficult to [[turn undead|turn]] and becomes more powerful as the shadowdancer gains [[class level|level]]s.

name: Summon undead
description:
The pale master can [[summon]] an [[undead]] creature twice per day as a spell-like ability.
The [[class level|level]] of the pale master determines the type of undead that is summoned:
* Level 4 and 5: [[ghoul (summon)|ghoul]]
* Level 6: [[shadow]]
* Level 7: [[ghast (summon)|ghast]]
* Level 8: [[wight]]
* Level 9: [[wraith]]

name: Superior initiative
description: The character gains a +8 bonus on [[initiative]] checks.

name: Superior weapon focus

repeatable_raw.quote: The weapon master gains a +1 bonus to all [[attack roll]]s with their weapon of choice.

description: The weapon master gains a +1 bonus to all [[attack roll]]s with their weapon of choice.

name: Terrifying rage
description: While the [[barbarian]] is ''raging'', any enemy (with less than the barbarian's [[hit dice]]) that comes close to him must make a [[will]] save opposed by the barbarian's intimidate check or become [[paralysis|panicked]] for <del>1d6</del> ''1[[d3]]'' [[round]]s. Opponents with up to twice the barbarian's hit dice will not flee but will receive a -2 penalty to [[attack roll|attack]] and [[saving throw]] rolls. Creatures with <del>more than</del> ''at least'' twice the barbarian's hit dice are not affected by the rage.

name: Thug
description: The character gains a +2 bonus on [[initiative]] checks and a +2 bonus on [[persuade]] checks.

name: Thundering rage
description: Any weapon the [[barbarian]] wields while in a [[barbarian rage|rage]] does an additional 2[[d6]] points of damage on a [[critical hit]]. There is a <del>50%</del> ''25%'' chance for a creature hit by one of the barbarian's weapons to be [[deaf]]ened for 3 [[round]]s.

name: Tough as bone
description: The pale master becomes immune to [[stunned|stun]], hold, and [[paralyze|paralyzation]].

name: Toughness
description: A character with this feat is tougher than normal, gaining one bonus [[hit point]] per [[character level|level]]. Hit points are gained retroactively when choosing this feat.

name: Trackless step
description: This feat grants a +4 competence bonus to [[hide]] and [[move silently]] checks when in wilderness areas.

name: Turn undead
use: selected. If the character has twice as many levels as the undead have [[hit dice]], the undead are instantly destroyed.
description: With this feat, the character can force [[undead]] to [[turned|flee in terror]]. This ability may be activated three times per day, plus the character's [[charisma]] [[modifier]]. The character's level and charisma are used to determine how many undead are turned.

name: Two-weapon fighting
description: A character with this [[feat]] reduces the penalties suffered when [[dual-wield|fighting with two weapons]]. The normal penalty of -6 to the primary hand and -10 to the [[off-hand]] becomes -4 for the primary hand and -8 for the off-hand. The [[ambidexterity]] feat further reduces the attack penalty for the second weapon by 4 (to -4/-4). Best results are achieved if the off-hand weapon is [[light weapon|light]], further reducing the penalty for both the primary and off-hand by 2 (to -2/-2).

name: Tymora's smile
description: Once per day, the Harper or a [[target]] receives a +2 [[saving throw]] bonus on all saving throws for 5 [[turn]]s.

name: Uncanny dodge
description:
There are six versions of this feat, with cumulative (but not [[stack]]ing) benefits. (Assassins and shadowdancers only qualify for the first three versions.) The sixth version includes benefits extending into [[epic class]] levels. '''I:''' The character retains his [[dexterity]] bonus to [[armor class|AC]], even if caught [[flat-foot]]ed or attacked by a hidden or [[invisible]] creature. '''II:''' This feat grants a +1 bonus on [[reflex]] [[saving throw]]s made to avoid [[trap]]s. '''III:''' This feat grants a +2 bonus on reflex saving throws made to avoid traps. '''IV:''' This feat grants a +3 bonus on reflex saving throws made to avoid traps. '''V:''' This feat grants a +4 bonus on reflex saving throws made to avoid traps. '''VI+:''' This feat grants a +5 bonus on reflex saving throws made to avoid traps.
Epic progression: The ''uncanny dodge'' bonus improves by +1 every three [[class level|level]]s.

name: Undead graft
description: Two times per day a pale master may use their undead arm to [[paralyze]] foes. At level 8 this may be used three times per day.

name: Undead shape
use: selected. After choosing this ability, the character must select an undead type to change into.
description:
The character with this ability can [[polymorph|transform into]] a selection of powerful [[undead]] creatures three times per day:
[[risen lord form|risen lord]], [[vampire form|vampire]], and [[spectre form|spectre]].

name: Use poison
description: The character is trained in the use of [[poison (item)|poison]] and never has to make a [[dexterity]] check when applying poison to a blade.

name: Venom immunity
description: The druid is immune to all [[poison]]s.

name: Weapon finesse
use: Automatic when using any of the following weapons: [[dagger]], [[handaxe]], [[kama]], [[kukri]], [[light hammer]], [[mace]], [[rapier]], [[shortsword]], [[sickle]], [[whip]], and [[unarmed strike]].
description: A character with this feat is adept at using light weapons subtly and effectively, allowing him to make melee attack rolls with his [[dexterity]] [[modifier]] instead of [[strength]] (if his dexterity is higher than his strength).

name: Weapon focus
prereq_raw: proficiency with the chosen weapon, [[base attack bonus]] +1
required_for_raw: [[weapon specialization]], [[epic weapon focus]], [[arcane archer]], [[champion of Torm]], [[weapon master]]

repeatable.quote: This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not [[stack]]. It applies to a new weapon in each case.

use: automatic. This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not [[stack]]. It applies to a new weapon in each case.
description: A character with this feat is particularly skilled with a specific weapon, gaining a +1 [[attack roll|attack]] bonus with it.

name: Weapon of choice

repeatable.quote: epic]] weapon master to take additional weapons of choice as class [[epic bonus feat]]s (provided the weapon focus prerequisites are met).

description: The weapon chosen to be a '''weapon of choice''' by a [[weapon master]] becomes the focus for all of their special abilities.

name: Weapon proficiency (creature)
description: This feat grants proficiency in the [[creature weapon]].

name: Weapon proficiency (druid)
use: All druids start with this feat and cannot gain weapon proficiency with any other weapons.
description:
This feat allows the character to use the [[club]], [[dagger]], [[dart]], [[quarterstaff]], [[scimitar]], [[sickle]], [[sling]], and [[spear]].
'''Normal:''' A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.

name: Weapon proficiency (elf)
use: All elves start with this feat but can gain other weapon proficiencies as well.
description:
This feat allows the character to use the [[longsword]], [[rapier]], [[longbow]], and [[shortbow]].
'''Normal:''' A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.

name: Weapon proficiency (exotic)
description:
This feat allows effective use of all exotic weapons. The exotic weapons list includes the [[bastard sword]], [[dire mace]], [[dwarven waraxe]]*, [[double axe]], [[kama]], [[katana]], [[kukri]], [[scythe]], [[shuriken]], [[whip]]*, and [[two-bladed sword]].
* exclusive to [[Hordes of the Underdark]]
'''Normal:''' A character cannot equip weapons they are not proficient in.

name: Weapon proficiency (martial)
use: [[Barbarian]]s, [[fighter]]s, [[paladin]]s, and [[ranger]]s are automatically proficient with all martial weapons.
description:
This feat allows effective use of all martial weapons. The martial weapons list includes the [[battleaxe]], [[greataxe]], [[greatsword]], [[halberd]], [[handaxe]], [[heavy flail]], [[light flail]], [[light hammer]], [[longbow]], [[longsword]], [[rapier]], [[scimitar]], [[shortsword]], [[shortbow]], [[throwing axe]], [[trident]], and [[warhammer]].
'''Normal:''' A character cannot equip weapons they are not proficient in.

name: Weapon proficiency (monk)
use: All monks start with this feat but can gain other weapon proficiencies as well.
description:
This feat allows effective use of [[club]], [[dagger]], [[handaxe]], [[light crossbow]], [[heavy crossbow]], [[quarterstaff]], [[shuriken]], [[kama]], and [[sling]].
'''Normal:''' A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.

name: Weapon proficiency (rogue)
use: All rogues start with this feat but can gain other weapon proficiencies as well.
description:
This feat allows the character to use the [[club]], [[dagger]], [[dart]], [[handaxe]], [[light crossbow]], [[heavy crossbow]], [[quarterstaff]], [[mace]], [[shortsword]], [[rapier]], [[shortbow]], [[morningstar]], and [[sling]].
'''Normal:''' A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.

name: Weapon proficiency (simple)
use: All characters except for [[druid]]s, [[monk]]s, [[rogue]]s, and [[wizard]]s are automatically proficient with all simple weapons. <del>The spell ''Tenser's transformation'' gives a wizard a temporary proficiency with all simple weapons.</del>
description:
This feat allows effective use of all simple weapons, including the [[club]], [[dagger]], [[mace]], [[sickle]], [[spear]], [[morningstar]], [[quarterstaff]], [[light crossbow|light]] and [[heavy crossbow]]s, [[dart]], and [[sling]].
'''Normal:''' A character cannot equip weapons they are not proficient in.

name: Weapon proficiency (wizard)
use: All wizards start with this feat but can gain other weapon proficiencies as well.
description:
This feat allows the character to use the [[club]], [[dagger]], [[light crossbow]], [[heavy crossbow]], and [[quarterstaff]].
'''Normal:''' A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.

name: Weapon specialization

repeatable.quote: This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not [[stack]]. It applies to a new weapon in each case.

use: This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not [[stack]]. It applies to a new weapon in each case.
description: A [[character]] with this [[feat]] has trained especially hard with a specific [[weapon]] type, and gains a +2 damage bonus when using these weapons in combat.

template.special: [[Halfling]]s and [[gnome]]s are small creatures and as such they can never use the following large weapons: [[dire mace]], [[two-bladed sword]], [[double axe]], [[greataxe]], [[greatsword]], [[halberd]], [[heavy flail]], and [[scythe]].

name: Whirlwind attack
description: The character performs a full attack action, and makes one melee attack at full base attack bonus against each opponent within 5 feet.

name: Wholeness of body
description: The monk can heal damage equal to twice her [[class level]], once per day.

name: Wild shape
use:
selected. After choosing the ability, the character must choose an
animal form to take.
description: The character with this ability can [[polymorph|take the shape of]] an animal at will. It may be used once per day at fifth level, twice per day at sixth level, three times per day at seventh level, four times per day at tenth level, five times per day at fourteenth level, and six times per day at eighteenth level. The transformation has a duration of 1 [[hour]] per [[class level]].

name: Woodland stride
description: The character is immune to the ''[[grease]]'', ''[[web]]'', and [[entangle (spell)|''entangle'']] spells.

name: Zen archery
description: Wisdom guides the character's ranged attacks, letting them use their wisdom [[ability modifier|modifier]], if it is higher, instead of their [[dexterity]] when firing [[ranged weapon]]s.
